query:
Industry: dental clinic
Client brief: Noor Dental, a calm dental clinic in Lahore for people anxious about visiting a dentist. English with an Urdu welcome. Explain first visits and treatment options clearly. Let visitors request an appointment. Soft sage, warm white, no animation, no invented doctors, testimonials, ratings or clinical promises. Illustrative photos must be labelled.
Audience: Lahore residents and anxious first-time patients
Primary action: request an appointment
Brand colours: #E7EDE7, #173C37, #FBFAF6
No animation.
No invented doctors.
No unverified clinical claims.

matched_industry.name: Healthcare, Clinical & Wellness
matched_industry.layout_archetype: Patient-First Action Hero + Care Pathway & Provider Directory
matched_industry.first_viewport_priority: Immediate appointment/triage action, insurance/care clarity, WCAG AAA-leaning readability

palette.notes: Brief colours #E7EDE7, #173C37, #FBFAF6 lead: #E7EDE7 is the ground; #173C37 as accents; #FBFAF6 as surfaces and deep tones, never accents | base Mineral-spa stone with eucalyptus and clay

conversion_trust_elements: Clinician registration shown the local way (e.g. GOC / NHS in the UK, state licence in the US)
Plain-language privacy note for health data
matched_industry.motion_language: Gentle opacity/height transitions (200ms); zero vestibular-triggering parallax

category_cliches: Stock smiling-professional photo on a teal gradient
Icon trio (heart, shield, clock) with three vague promises
Template hero (headline left, illustration right, two buttons)
Uniform card grids with icon + heading + paragraph
Gradient blobs and glassmorphism with no brand reason
distinctiveness.instruction: Subject first: list the objects, tools and moments a visitor actually sees in this business (a bakery: loaves, the oven, flour; an optician: frames, lenses, the test chart). The first screen must show the most characteristic of them as authored art at scale, so a stranger can name the business with the text covered. Then write down 3 concrete references from the brand's own world (local architecture, craft traditions, signage, landscape, the material itself) and derive palette, pattern, and type voice from them. Place: Lahore — what does it look like there, specifically? The clichés below are generic *treatments* (layouts, kits, palettes), not the subject's own objects: avoid the treatments, never the subject.

matched_styles.name: Swiss Editorial Grid
characteristics: Exposed structural grid borders (`1px solid`) with generous internal cell padding
High-contrast serif or neo-grotesque display headlines paired with crisp body copy
Asymmetric column ratios (e.g., 4:8 or 5:7) with clear typographic hierarchy

matched_styles.name: Atelier Tactile Minimalism
characteristics: Warm paper and limestone neutrals (`#FAF8F5`) rather than sterile `#FFFFFF`
Unhurried vertical rhythm (`96px–140px` section spacing) and monograph captions
Zero decorative card wrappers; imagery and typography sit directly on the canvas

matched_styles.name: Crisp Product Workbench
characteristics: Interactive live product state demonstrations in the hero instead of static screenshots
Subtle surface layering (`#FCFCFA` -> `#F2F3EE`) with crisp 1px borders
Clear scannable feature proof and transparent pricing architecture

directions.title: Direction A — Healthcare, Clinical & Wellness (Arched Window)
directions.layout_composition: Dental clinic in Lahore framed in an arch: the treatment room photographed through an arched window shape, the headline wrapping its curve; the appointment slot and the clinician in smaller arches below; 'request an appointment' under the first arch. Structure: the photo framed in an arch with the headline wrapping it. Knobs: density airy; span irregularity medium; accent on the primary action only. Mobile: the arch narrows and sits above the headline
directions.visual_identity: Soft architecture: Brygada 1918 for headings, Assistant for text; palette brand-e7ede7-173c37-fbfaf6-on-mineral-spa (light ground): brief colours #e7ede7, #173c37, #fbfaf6 lead: #e7ede7 is the ground; #173c37 as accents; #fbfaf6 as surfaces and deep tones, never accents; arches only on images, square elsewhere; corners: arch-topped images and frames, 4px controls (arched); body 1rem (16px) minimum, labels and captions 0.75rem (12px) minimum; fallbacks Brygada 1918: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; Assistant: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

palette.notes: Brief colours #E7EDE7, #173C37, #FBFAF6 lead: #E7EDE7 is the ground; #173C37 as accents; #FBFAF6 as surfaces and deep tones, never accents | base Mineral-spa stone with eucalyptus and clay

directions.motion_choreography: No motion: the treatment room and every section render in their final state on load; hover and focus change colour only; nothing moves on scroll
directions.rationale: Arched Window for "dental clinic" (general surface): the place is the product, and framing it like a doorway invites the visitor in. Type Brygada 1918 / Assistant (commemorative serif, quiet sans) for an editorial voice, tagged calm like the brief. Palette brand-e7ede7-173c37-fbfaf6-on-mineral-spa on a light ground, tagged care/calm like the brief. First screen: stacked composition (no fitting object-wrap hero for this trade, so the direction follows the dealt hero hero-folder-tabs), hero material photo, look family soft-organic, corners arched. Motion flavour (tier and tools follow page_shape.motion): the arch opens slightly on load. Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Brand first: palette built around the brief's colours (#E7EDE7, #173C37, #FBFAF6). Other structures that fit this slot: Long Read.

flow.build: One continuous rail runs down the page; every section hangs off it in order.

section_head.build: Title left, short note right on one shared baseline.

ground.build: Light ground throughout; sections separate by space and rules, not colour.

material.build: Diagrams and technical drawings: plans, exploded views, flow lines and callouts.

labels.build: A short accent dash before each label, body face semibold, sentence case.

motion.build: Micro motion only: hover, focus and press states (150-200ms), no scroll choreography; signature: focus-draw (CSS transitions). Reduced motion: under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every effect is replaced by its final state; all content stays visible and readable.

motion_techniques.build: Focus rings draw around controls in 150ms.

motif.build: Arch top: media frames and the main feature panel rise into one round arch drawn from the treatment room; one arch, one radius, repeated.

button.build: Primary: solid accent pill echoing the arch, 48px tall with 28px side padding; hover deepens the fill one step (150ms), press sinks it 1px, and keyboard focus shows a 2px accent ring offset 3px. Secondary: a pill of the same size with a 1px ink outline that fills on hover.

No monospace face: figures use the body face's tabular numerals.
No index numerals (01, 02) on sections or steps; an ordered list carries order.
No gradients, glows, glass panels or blobs: flat colour chapters carry the page.

At most two typefaces; hierarchy comes from size and weight.

The footer returns the brand line large across the full width.

workflow_guidance: ROTATION: tell the user in one line before dealing: The last 12 runs used atelier-minimalism 9 times, swiss-editorial-grid 7 times, block-first-editorial 5 times, crisp-product-workbench 5 times; this run picks from {hero-folder-tabs, hero-focus-band, hero-numeral-poster}.
BRIEF COLOURS: the brief names its own colours (#E7EDE7, #173C37, #FBFAF6). Use them as the palette in every direction (check WCAG pairs); the direction palettes below are fallbacks only.

RTL: the brief names a right-to-left language. Set `<html dir="rtl" lang="..">`, use logical CSS properties only (margin-inline-start, padding-inline, inset-inline-end, text-align: start, border-inline-start), mirror the layout and directional icons and motion (an entrance from the start edge comes from the right), keep numerals, code and brand marks LTR where they belong, and pick fonts that ship the script.

Mode A (New Website): the user's prompt wins over everything here. The 3 directions are structural raw material (layout, content treatment, dials), not finished looks; the visual world comes from art direction.

DISTINCTIVENESS: Read `distinctiveness` first. If `match_confidence` is `none` or `weak`, the industry profile is only a fallback; build the visual world from the brief's place and material cues instead, and do not ship any listed category cliché unless the brief asks for it.

ART DIRECTION (load `skills/layoza-art-direction`): commit to ONE specific world. Derive the world from far (place, notation, print traditions), keep the subject up close (the trade's object as the signature interaction, at scale), rule out the category reflex and its obvious opposite, and put the visitor's real action in the first viewport. Let colour own whole sections. Decide motion and tools per design; nothing is mandatory.

ENGINEERING LESSONS: sticky headers need `html { scroll-padding-top: <header height + 1rem> }` (WCAG 2.4.11); web fonts need metric-adjusted fallback `@font-face` (size-adjust / ascent-override) or the font swap re-wraps headings and fails CLS; scroll reveals must end visible.

HERO: Layoza does not fix the first-screen composition; you choose it, from the subject and the brief. The directions suggest stacked / full-bleed / poster (each with its reason in `rationale`), and the dealt hero mechanic is one fit for that composition, not the only one. Give the three directions three different first screens, do not default to headline-left / visual-right (a split needs a stated reason), and record `HERO:` with the reason in `.layoza/direction.md`.
TYPE & LEADING: Keep multi-line display headings at `line-height >= 1.0` so ascenders and descenders never collide.

LAYOUT SAFETY: Keep short header links/buttons on one line (`white-space: nowrap`), give side-by-side heading columns >= 16px of clear space, collapse multi-column grids before gaps exceed the viewport, and size any <canvas> from a fixed-size container with devicePixelRatio capped at 2.
Verify in a real browser with `layoza qa <file-or-url>` (1440/768/375): it measures contrast, overflow, clipping, nav, scroll reveals, and lab Core Web Vitals; fix every error.

DIRECTIONS: render three materially different compositions with identical factual content and available assets at desktop and phone sizes. Compare the actual renders for hierarchy, typography, image integration, clarity and full-page rhythm. Choose with reasons as the designer unless the user asked to choose. Persist candidates, screenshot evidence and visible tradeoffs with review_design; never invent user approval. Library deals are starting material, not mandatory shapes or a substitute for art direction.

PAGE SHAPE: each direction's `page_shape` is a set of suggestions, not orders. Decide every axis (hero frame, flow, section heads, ground, material, labels, motion level and tools) from this brief's facts; keep a suggestion only when it serves your concept, and record each decision with its reason in .layoza/direction.md. Axes in `pinned_by_prompt` follow the user's words; whatever you choose stays unique against the ledger.

FORM: for each page or section answer narrative role, viewing distance, visual temperature, content capacity and visual motif before styling it; at delivery add one line per section saying which content the form came from.

COPY: specific nouns from the brief, no startup clichés, no invented metrics, reviews or logo walls (use honest placeholders such as `[customer quote — to supply]`), and call-to-action verbs taken from what the visitor actually does.

SELF-CRITIQUE before QA: score philosophy, hierarchy, execution, specificity, restraint, variety from 1 to 5; any score below 3 means revise first. Put the stamp `/* layoza · direction: <A|B|C> · structure: <style_family> · hero: <hero id> · palette: <palette id> · type: <type id> · critique: P4 H4 E4 S4 R4 V4 */` as the first line of the main CSS (your direction, structure, hero, palette, type and scores).
LOOK LEDGER: steered away from 36 look(s) in this project's last 12 run(s) (.layoza/looks.jsonl); 32 slot repeat(s) remain (see `uniqueness`). Pass ledger=false (CLI --no-ledger) to ignore it.
rotation: The last 12 runs used atelier-minimalism 9 times, swiss-editorial-grid 7 times, block-first-editorial 5 times, crisp-product-workbench 5 times; this run picks from {hero-folder-tabs, hero-focus-band, hero-numeral-poster}.

concepts.title: Direction B — Healthcare, Clinical & Wellness (Full-Bleed Stage)
concepts.composition: Full-bleed stage for the dental clinic in Lahore: the treatment room fills the first screen edge to edge with the headline set into its quiet area; later sections cut between the appointment slot and the clinician at full width; 'request an appointment' stays docked and usable at every scroll position. Structure: one subject image edge to edge, headline in its quiet area, full-width cuts, docked action. Knobs: density standard; span irregularity medium; accent on the primary action only. Mobile: the image crops to a 4:5 focal point chosen by hand; the headline moves under it, never over a busy area
concepts.why_this_subject: Full-Bleed Stage for "dental clinic" (general surface): atmosphere sells it: the place, the product or the work has to be felt before it is read. Type Geist / Geist (terminal-native, exacting, transcript-led) for an expressive voice. Palette brand-e7ede7-173c37-fbfaf6-on-night-ward on a light ground, tagged care/calm like the brief. First screen: full-bleed composition, hero material photo, look family cinematic-dark, corners sharp-0. Motion flavour (tier and tools follow page_shape.motion): slow cross-fades; plates hand off on scroll. Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Brand first: palette built around the brief's colours (#E7EDE7, #173C37, #FBFAF6).

concepts.title: Direction C — Healthcare, Clinical & Wellness (Price Board)
concepts.composition: Dental clinic in Lahore opens on the price board: every common job or item with its price, time and what is included (appointment times, treatment names and prices); the treatment room first, the appointment slot and the clinician as worked examples; 'request an appointment' as a short form directly under the board. Structure: a full price list as the first screen with a quote form under it. Knobs: density standard; span irregularity low; accent on links and the primary action. Mobile: the list stays a list; each line wraps price under the name
concepts.why_this_subject: Price Board for "dental clinic" (general surface): price is the visitor's first question, and answering it openly beats a contact form. Type Familjen Grotesk / Public Sans (clean, quietly characterful) for a utility voice, tagged care like the brief. Palette brand-e7ede7-173c37-fbfaf6-on-clean-room on a light ground, tagged care/calm like the brief. First screen: poster composition (no fitting stacked hero for this trade, so the direction follows the dealt hero hero-numeral-poster), hero material document, look family swiss-grid, corners hairline-2. Motion flavour (tier and tools follow page_shape.motion): none beyond focus. Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Brand first: palette built around the brief's colours (#E7EDE7, #173C37, #FBFAF6).

creative_workspace.selection: Render the three concepts with identical real content and available assets. Pick the clearest, most expressive, subject-specific composition; record the decision and visible tradeoffs with review_design. Familiar controls may be reused when they serve the task.
creative_workspace.novelty: A supporting signal, never a reason to change a working brand or navigation pattern
creative_workspace.design_gate: Browser defects and recorded process only. Exceptional design requires reviewing the actual renders, not passing a numeric checker.

client_request: Noor Dental, a calm dental clinic in Lahore for people anxious about visiting a dentist. English with an Urdu welcome. Explain first visits and treatment options clearly. Let visitors request an appointment. Soft sage, warm white, no animation, no invented doctors, testimonials, ratings or clinical promises. Illustrative photos must be labelled.
craft_floor: Header: one row, 60-88px tall on desktop and 56-76px on mobile; logo 24-40px high on the left, 4-6 nav links of 15-16px at weight 500 with 24-40px between them, the primary action on the right at the header's button size. Phone or hours sit in that row or the footer; no utility bar stacked above the nav. Mark the current link with a 2px underline 6px below the text; a sticky header turns opaque after the first scroll, never taller.

Primary button: 48-60px tall, horizontal padding 20-32px (about twice the vertical), label 15-17px at weight 600 in sentence or title case with tracking 0-0.02em, at most one drawn SVG icon of 16-20px set 8px from the label. The secondary action matches its height, radius and padding as an outline (1-1.5px) or ghost; one button shape and radius on the whole page, 44px minimum hit area everywhere.
Button states: author hover, :active, disabled and :focus-visible feedback without movement. Use a visible 2px focus ring with 3:1 contrast; do not change the control's size or hide its label.

Type scale: at most 8 distinct font sizes each carry 2% or more of the text on a desktop render, each step at least 1.2x the one below; body 18-21px at line-height 1.5-1.65; headings at line-height 1.0-1.15. The h1 tops out at 80px on desktop (set with clamp()), and display sizes of 48px and up track -0.02 to -0.04em, never tighter than -0.05em; body text keeps tracking at 0.
Measure: prose never runs past 76 characters a line (cap paragraphs at 60-68ch with max-width); h1 lines stay under 20ch and h2 under 24ch; no centred paragraph runs past three lines.

Spacing rhythm: use a coherent scale suited to density and content. Group related controls tightly and separate different tasks clearly. Preserve incumbent tokens; do not impose fixed section padding or an arbitrary 4/8px scale on every project.

Section heads: one heading per section (one h2, or the h1 in the hero) and at most one lead paragraph of 40 words or fewer. No stacked pile of label, heading, accent-coloured second heading and paragraph; a second voice goes in the body, not the head.

Composition: choose section forms from the content and reading order. Repeated rows, equal cards and consistent app panels are useful when people compare equivalent items. Vary composition only when it improves hierarchy; no minimum number of layout kinds.

Hero: establish the subject, dominant visual relationship and useful next action. Let the actual content determine the number of pictures, amount of copy and first-screen balance; no mandatory picture or fixed text-block quota.

Imagery: use relevant, licensed material and truthful labels. Decide crop and aspect ratio for each image's role; no universal ratio or radius. Label illustrative stock near the image and never imply it shows the actual client. Text on images must remain readable at 4.5:1.

Colour: respect pinned brand colours and monochrome constraints. Assign clear roles to grounds, text, actions and status; choose saturation and colour area from the concept, without an accent-area quota. Body and secondary text need 4.5:1 contrast, large text 3:1.

Icons: one drawn SVG set at one stroke weight (1.5 or 2px) and one size per context (16, 20 or 24px), coloured with currentColor. Never a Unicode arrow, check mark, star or emoji standing in for an icon.

Motion: none. Render essential content in its final visible state; no entrance, hover movement, autoplay or signature animation. Focus and state changes remain clear without movement, including under prefers-reduced-motion.

Footer: brand and one-line description, two or three link groups and the contact block, four columns at most on desktop; group titles 13-14px at weight 600 in sentence case; links 15-16px with 10-12px between rows; a bottom bar for legal and copyright at 13-14px; 64px or more of top padding.

Browser surfaces: ::selection and focus rings use the palette; link underlines sit 3-4px below the text at 1-2px thickness; tables and figures use tabular numerals; no unthemed default blue links anywhere.
Civic: plain language at 18px or more, every action a labelled button of 48px or taller, contrast 7:1 for body text where possible, no motion needed to understand anything.

design_critique.note: Stylistic devices are not defects by themselves. Diagnose the actual composition, not a list of banned looks.
